top_creatures.label: Dune wyrm in three sizes
top_creatures.why: One stat block and size alone reads as the tier at 375 wide; adolescent, ancient and grand share level 336, HAM 410000, damage and resists.
top_creatures.keep: Identical stat block across sizes; size as the tier cue; a +100 accuracy bonus on the two larger sizes only.
top_creatures.change: Our own scale ramp and a distinct roar per size; move the accuracy bonus to the top size only.

top_creatures.label: Venom brood matron
top_creatures.why: A 1.75 scale spider whose two attack lists are area poison and strong poison.
top_creatures.keep: Paired area and single poison attack set; scale step to a large spider.
top_creatures.change: A visible poison pool telegraph before the bite; our own damage type.

top_creatures.label: Brood tyrant
top_creatures.why: Scale 4.0, HAM 41000, level 126: the largest creature in the spider family.
top_creatures.keep: A 4x silhouette jump for the boss step.
top_creatures.change: Our own egg-sac look and an attack set that is not poison-only.

top_creatures.label: Nest ladder, hatchling to queen
top_creatures.why: Named stages that read by size and name; the queen tops a nest.
top_creatures.keep: Hatchling 7 to queen 26 as separate templates.
top_creatures.change: The queen as a clear-the-nest objective with egg-sac loot.

top_creatures.label: Pack beast with a late marauder tier
top_creatures.why: Top tier at level 173 with HAM 120000 and scale 1.35 after tiers at 30 to 50.
top_creatures.keep: Pack-plus-killer flags and a sharp HAM jump.
top_creatures.change: Gate the tier by a zone difficulty band, not a level number.

top_creatures.label: Armoured herd leader
top_creatures.why: Herd boss at level 129, HAM 81000, low resists (25 to 35): a fight that is easy to hit.
top_creatures.keep: Herd and killer flags; the low resist profile.
top_creatures.change: A plated back and a crest look of our own.

top_creatures.label: Resist-wall beast
top_creatures.why: Three resist slots at 200 force a weapon swap.
top_creatures.keep: A nine-slot resist vector with several near-immune slots (slot order not read).
top_creatures.change: Our own damage type names; the immunity shown as a sheen on the hide.

top_creatures.label: Union-of-masters elite caster
top_creatures.why: Level 277 caster whose attacks merge five master ability lists.
top_creatures.keep: Merging several master ability lists into one elite.
top_creatures.change: Our own ability set and a silhouette that reads at 375 wide.

looks.label: Hue-index skins
looks.technique: One model with an index list drawn from four blocks of eight (0 to 7, 8 to 15, 16 to 23, 24 to 31); palette ramp is client-side and absent.

looks.label: Scale tiers
looks.technique: A scale multiplier per variant with the same stat block (dragon sizes 0.85, 2.05, 2.35); most common scales 1.05 to 1.25.

looks.label: Glowing swarm
looks.technique: A particle emitter for an ambient glowing flock, named by template only.

looks.label: Glowing light and volcano glow
looks.technique: Particle emitters named for glowing light and glow effects (names only).

looks.label: Gold-trim NPC variants
looks.technique: An outfit variant with a gold finish; about 24 template files carry gold in the name. Visual is in .iff (absent).

looks.label: Poison gas cloud
looks.technique: A dungeon hazard object; name only.

originals.name: Scale-tier wyrm
originals.idea: A dragon-like beast in three sizes that share one stat block, so size alone signals the tier at 375 wide.
originals.keep: One stat block across sizes; size as the tier cue.
originals.change: Our own scales, a distinct roar per size, the accuracy bonus only on the top size.

originals.name: Brood matron with a poison pool
originals.idea: A large spider with an area poison and a single poison attack, telegraphed by a pool on the ground.
originals.keep: Paired area and single poison attack set; a scale step to a boss size.
originals.change: A visible pool telegraph; our own damage type.

originals.name: Nest ladder with a queen objective
originals.idea: Named nest stages from hatchling to queen; clearing the queen ends the nest.
originals.change: Egg-sac loot and a nest-clearing objective.

originals.name: Herd leader with a pack link
originals.idea: A herd grazer whose leader pulls nearby herd members into the fight when hit.
originals.keep: PACK and HERD flags as data.
originals.change: A plated look and our own call.

originals.name: Nine-slot resist vector
originals.idea: A beast with several near-immune damage slots that forces a weapon swap.
originals.keep: A nine-slot vector with several near-immune slots.
originals.change: Our damage names; immunity shown as a sheen on the hide.

originals.name: Elite built from masters
originals.idea: A caster whose ability list merges several master lists.
originals.keep: Merging several master ability lists into one elite.
originals.change: Our own ability set and silhouette.

originals.name: Forged blade ladder
originals.idea: Five blade tiers gated by certificates, with the wounds ratio as the hidden power step.
originals.keep: Five tiers; a certificate gate; the wounds ratio step.
originals.change: Our own element and a visible glow per tier.

originals.name: Mastery-count unlock
originals.idea: A class unlocks after mastering six of many tracks.
originals.change: Our own tracks (for example six of twelve stances).

originals.name: Level-banded stat table with quality bands
originals.idea: One 200-row table with banded increments, scaled by a quality band.
originals.keep: One table, banded increments, a quality band.
originals.change: Our own numbers; a comment that matches the table (the donor's hit-band comment disagrees with its table).

originals.name: Empty-zone despawn with grace
originals.idea: A zone object despawns after a grace period with no players in range, cancelled on entry, re-checked when it fires.
originals.keep: Grace timer; cancel on entry; re-check at fire time.
originals.change: Track counted players as a set so a visibility change cannot desync the count.

licence_note: README and COPYING say GNU AGPL v3. Many Lua data files carry a GNU LGPL header (audit AU051: 18,274 of 30,521 .lua files in bin/scripts contain GNU Lesser text; none contain GNU Affero). The two statements conflict. Asset licence: none in repo; game-data origin not stated. Client art absent. Treat as shape only, not a copy. Not a legal view.
